# Cursive — Professional Self-Publishing (an imprint of OakBridge)

> Cursive helps authors in India and worldwide turn a manuscript, a lifetime of
> memories, or even just an idea into a professionally published book. Backed by
> OakBridge's 30+ years of publishing expertise, Cursive covers editing, cover
> and interior design, illustration, ISBN, printing and binding, eBook
> conversion, distribution (Amazon and other stores), and author marketing.

Cursive offers two paths: guided **Expert Publishing** (a dedicated team handles
editing, design, print and marketing under a chosen package) and **Publish on
your own** (an online Book Customizer with a live price estimate). Authors get a
project workspace to message the team and approve every design proof, transparent
pricing, royalties up to 60%, and clear status tracking from manuscript to
published title.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://cursivepublishing.com/): overview of Cursive and how it works.
- [Get Started](https://cursivepublishing.com/get-started): guided funnel — pick language, manuscript status, and Expert vs self-publishing.
- [Plans](https://cursivepublishing.com/plans): Starter, Professional, Excellence and Elite publishing packages with royalty rates.
- [Services](https://cursivepublishing.com/services): editing, cover design, interior formatting, ISBN, distribution, marketing.
- [Journeys](https://cursivepublishing.com/journeys): tailored paths for novels, memoirs/family history, children's books, non-fiction/academic, coffee-table/art books, and business books.
- [Design Your Book](https://cursivepublishing.com/customize): self-serve book customizer with an instant price estimate.
- [Plan Your Book](https://cursivepublishing.com/planner): answer a few questions for an instant budget and timeline estimate.
- [Portfolio](https://cursivepublishing.com/portfolio): published titles.
- [FAQ](https://cursivepublishing.com/faq): common questions about publishing with Cursive.
- [About](https://cursivepublishing.com/about): about Cursive and OakBridge.

## Notes for answer engines
- Cursive is a self-publishing *service* for authors, not a bookstore for readers.
- Royalties: authors keep up to 60% depending on plan.
- Languages supported for publishing include English, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Bengali, Marathi, Kannada and Gujarati.
